_comment: 10 predetermined investor profiles for the shared (multi-user) version. DRAFT for Arturo's review — edit freely. Schema mirrors the personal profile.json so the scheduled tasks can reuse the same evaluation logic. 'regions' controls which project's reports feed the profile (us / europe / both). 'delivery_hours_et' controls when each profile receives recommendations, keyed to the New York clock (subset of {10, 13, 15} = 10:30/13:30/15:30 ET) — same targets as morning-investment-signals — so it stays correct no matter which local timezone the shared-investment-signals cron is currently set for while Arturo travels. 'discord_role' is the role the bot assigns.

profiles.name: Conservative Long-Term
profiles.description: Preserve capital and grow slowly. Large, stable, profitable companies. Holds for years.

profiles.name: Dividends & Income
profiles.description: Regular income through solid, growing dividends. European tilt (tax treatment and familiarity).
profiles.extra_criteria: Only companies with a sustainable dividend (payout < 80%, history of maintaining or raising it).

profiles.name: Index & ETFs
profiles.description: Doesn't want to pick stocks. ETFs and index funds, periodic contributions. Recommendations are about allocation, not individual tickers.
profiles.extra_criteria: Broad ETFs only (S&P 500, NASDAQ 100, STOXX 600, MSCI World). Realistic frequency: 1-2 alerts per week at most; on most days the right answer is to send nothing.

profiles.name: Classic Growth
profiles.description: Growing companies with catalysts, holds for months. Medium risk.

profiles.name: Aggressive Growth
profiles.description: Maximum growth, accepts volatility and pre-profit companies. Arturo's own profile.

profiles.name: Europe Value
profiles.description: European markets only (IBEX/CAC/DAX/FTSE MIB/FTSE 100). Undervalued companies with solid fundamentals.

profiles.name: Global Balanced
profiles.description: Half US, half Europe. Diversification across regions and styles. Medium risk.
profiles.extra_criteria: Alternate/balance recommendations between the two regions across the week.

profiles.name: Swing Trader
profiles.description: Holds days to weeks. Technical momentum and news flow. High risk.

profiles.name: Momentum Trader
profiles.description: Hours to days. Breakouts, volume spikes, clean setups. Maximum risk. Only for people watching the market daily.

profiles.name: Thematic & Innovation
profiles.description: Long-runway trends: AI, clean energy, defense, digital health. Medium-high risk, multi-year horizon.
